### contamination_disclosure

None from the source layer. One honest note: the auditor read the full `user_scenario` script, which is part of the runtime view by the brief. The script says what the simulator will say *if* the agent explains that "something on the block has to be put through before the deposit can be worked out" and "if the agent then tells you that fewer room nights came off than you asked for". These are conditional simulator lines, not visible to the agent before the triggering event; they told the auditor that a reduction hop exists and that the removal is partial, but no figure. Every hop and number below was derived from KB sentences and query returns, which are quoted.

### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

- Target object: the Wedding room block with booking code YCW115 ("calling about your wedding room block, booking code YCW115").
- Action and timing: pay the second (interim) deposit today ("you want to pay the second deposit today with the card already on your profile"); she gives no amount ("You do not know what the amount should be and you never suggest one").
- Authorisation: she will run the payment herself when handed the step ("when the agent hands the payment step over to you, you run it yourself with exactly the amount and details the agent gives you"). She authorises whatever is needed for the paperwork ("tell them to go ahead and do whatever is needed for it").
- Simulator role: passive and conditional. It volunteers the reduction paperwork only after the agent explains a precondition, says "18 room nights but that the agent should go by what the paper says", and accepts a partial removal. It volunteers the Meetings & Events reception and Ashbury Rewards Platinum membership only if asked about other holdings.
- Identity: phone 619-555-5274 + ZIP 92103 → `verify_customer_identity` returned "Identity verified ... (2 detail(s) matched)".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse at the frozen moment

Act now, in two writes. Visible grounds:
- Block status `definite` (find_group_blocks). `interim_deposit_payment_254d0f13`: "The organiser pays the interim deposit of a tentative or definite block personally, with the card on their profile, once guest services has quoted the amount".
- No interim receipt yet: the ledger carries only `deposit_signing` (1,587.60, 2025-11-07) — "a block whose ledger already carries a receipt ... of the interim kind takes no second receipt of that kind" does not bar this payment.
- But the amount is not yet workable: "The interim deposit is worked out only after every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block is matched by a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it." find_group_amendments shows signed reduction `c24c37e5-…` (18 room nights, issued 2026-08-13) and find_group_ledger has no `group_block_reduce` entry naming it (the only reduction entry names `b03bc892-…`). So the reduction must be implemented first.
- Reduction eligibility: `contract_addenda_clause_6366a713` A.2 "A block is amended only while its status is definite" (definite); A.4 "must be signed no later than the block type's free-reduction deadline" — Wedding deadline 90 days before arrival (`addendum_allowance_terms_0cd7d375`), i.e. 2026-10-17 for arrival 2027-01-15; the addendum is already signed at the frozen moment 2026-10-07, so within it whatever its signature day. Not refused.
- The withdrawn reduction `ab25b41d-…` (10 room nights, 2026-09-24) is not signed: A.1 "takes effect only once its status is signed".

- Customer `da6a70af-b055-4d1d-999d-edea583d236e`; block `df35cc35-9a50-40ad-a1c2-e4569a7ee409` (Wedding Room Block, arrival 2027-01-15, proposal 2025-11-03, signed 2025-11-10, contracted 90, held 90, group rate 189.00, deposit held 1,587.60).
- Ledger rows read: allocation 84 (2025-11-03); signing deposit 1,587.60 (2025-11-07); increase 12 (2026-03-02, names `7613aae5`); reduction 6 (2026-06-22, names `b03bc892`).
- Addendum implemented: `c24c37e5-9684-43ee-9536-db54d41488a6` — "the most recently issued reduction addendum whose status is signed" (`reduction_addendum_implementation_f8085e4f`); the later `ab25b41d` is withdrawn and excluded; `b03bc892` already has its entry ("No addendum is implemented twice").

### 4. Scored parameters, formulas, tiers

**(a) Room nights removed by the reduction** (`free_reduction_allowance_worksheet_ce403a9d` + factor documents):
- Requested: 18 ("the requested room nights written on the most recently issued reduction addendum whose status is signed").
- Days before arrival of the reduction — `reduction_lead_time_count_41d66c89`: issued 2026-08-13, implemented 2026-10-07 = 55 days, "more than 30 but no more than 60 calendar days" → "the day 30 calendar days after the issue date" = 2026-09-12 → 125 days to 2027-01-15.
- Reduction percentage — `early_reduction_percentage_terms_65f40823`: 125 days is "at least 120 but fewer than 180"; signing deposit entry dated 2025-11-07, 4 days after the 2025-11-03 proposal, within the Wedding signing-deposit period of 7 → "the free-reduction percentage times 1.5" = 10 × 1.5 = 15 percent.
- Base — `allowance_base_after_increases_b62f630f`: latest increase entry 2026-03-02 is 112 days after the 2025-11-10 signing, "later than 90 calendar days" → 84 + 0.5 × 12 = 90 room nights.
- Courtesy — `rewards_courtesy_room_nights_b285dd46`: active Platinum Elite with 4 base-point stay credits in the last 24 months (≥ 3) → 4.
- Allowance: 15% × 90 = 13.5, rounded down 13, plus 4 = 17.
- Earlier reductions — `earlier_reduction_weighting_851eb781`: latest earlier reduction entry 2026-06-22 is 207 days before arrival, "180 or more" → 6 × 0.5 = 3.
- Still open: 17 − 3 = 14. Removed: lesser of 18 and 14 = **14** (4 requested room nights stay in the contract). Block after: contracted 76, held 76 (tool return confirmed).

**(b) Interim deposit amount** (`interim_deposit_amount_worksheet_b09ba005` + factor documents):
- Base interim percentage: Wedding 25 (`deposit_schedule_terms_1a35a041`).
- Event-deposit relief — `event_contract_deposit_relief_0fbee8c1`: linked contract definite, deposit held 5,362.50 ≥ 3,000 → −5 points.
- Late-receipt load — `interim_deposit_late_receipt_load_68ca9a5f`: due 120 days before arrival = 2026-09-17; paid 2026-10-07 → 20 days past due, "more than 14" → +5 points.
- Reduction exposure load — `reduction_exposure_load_4cf7f175`: reduction entries after implementation 6 + 14 = 20 against allocation 84 = 23.8 percent, "at least 15 percent" → +5 points. (Before implementation: 6/84 = 7.1 percent → +2.5; this is why the order matters.)
- Applicable interim percentage: 25 − 5 + 5 + 5 = 30.
- True-up — `interim_deposit_true_up_after_reductions_923c3ab3`: ledger carries reduction entries and the signing deposit entry is on time → branch 1: (30 + 10)% × (76 × 189.00 = 14,364.00) = 5,745.60, less all deposits received 1,587.60 = 4,158.00; rounded once to the cent: **4,158.00 USD**.

**Fall-back answers (computation documents alone, no factor):**
- Reduction: 10% × 84 = 8.4 → 8, courtesy none, earlier 6 in full → open 2 → removed **2** (≠ 14).
- Interim on the correct post-reduction record (contracted 76): 25% × 76 × 189.00 = **3,591.00** (≠ 4,158.00).
- Observation (not a document defect): a solver who applies *no* factor in *either* computation removes 2 room nights (contracted 88) and then computes 25% × 88 × 189.00 = 4,158.00 — the same interim amount as the full answer, by numerical coincidence (both equal 22 × 189.00). The reduction count (2 vs 14) still separates the two paths, but the interim amount alone does not discriminate the all-baseline path. Recorded for the policy side.
- Findability of each factor from the records' words: "reduction entries"/"signing deposit entry"/"increase entries"/"allocation entry" (find_group_ledger `event_type`/`entry_basis` words) lead to the allowance-base, weighting, early-percentage, exposure-load and true-up documents, all of which use "reduction entries", "allocation entry", "signing deposit entry"; the addendum `created_at` leads to the lead-time count ("issue date ... as shown on the addendum record"); "Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite" and `earning_source: stay_base` lead to the courtesy document ("base-point stay credits", "earning source is a stay's base points"); "Wedding Celebration Package"/"group_block_id" on find_meeting_contracts leads to the Meetings & Events relief document ("The Meetings & Events contract that names this group room block"); the due date and today lead to the late-receipt load. None of the computation documents mentions any variation; "the courtesy room nights are none" and "counted in full" are stated as default values.

1. agent `find_customers` → agent `verify_customer_identity` (phone + ZIP).
2. agent `find_group_blocks`, `find_group_ledger`, `find_group_amendments`; `find_loyalty_memberships`, `find_loyalty_transactions`; `find_meeting_contracts`.

4. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool("pay_group_deposit_93013531")` ("A customer-owned tool: guest services unlocks it and hands it over"), quoting `group_block_id` df35cc35-…, `entry_basis` `deposit_interim`, `deposit_amount` 4158.00.
5. user `call_user_discoverable_tool` → returned status "received", amount_paid 4158.0, deposit_held 5745.6; she reads back the receipt number.
Terminal: one new reduction entry (14) naming c24c37e5; one interim receipt of 4,158.00; contracted/held 76.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials

Problems: P1 implement the signed reduction addendum c24c37e5 (agent write); P0 the interim deposit payment (customer write, root).

- Hop P0 ← P1 — **state-derived**. Visible sentence on P0's hub (`interim_deposit_payment_254d0f13`): "The interim deposit is worked out only after every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block is matched by a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it." Query: find_group_amendments shows `c24c37e5` `room_night_reduction` `signed`; find_group_ledger has no `group_block_reduce` row with `amendment_id` c24c37e5. Searching the state's words ("reduction entry ... names the addendum") finds `reduction_addendum_implementation_f8085e4f`: "A signed reduction addendum on a definite block is implemented by one reduction entry on the block ledger that names the addendum", with its own agent tool. So the waited-on state is brought about by that implementation; nothing in P0's documents names that tool or that document.
- P1's own documents carry no waits-on sentence; the increase addendum `7613aae5` already has its entry; no further hop.
- Order: P1 then P0; the reduction entry also changes the exposure load and the contracted room nights read by P0.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternative objects: the withdrawn addendum (excluded by A.1 "takes effect only once its status is signed"); the already-implemented b03bc892 (excluded by A.6 "No addendum is implemented twice"); removing all 18 requested (excluded by "the lesser of the room nights requested and the allowance still open" and "Room nights an addendum requests beyond the allowance still open are not removed").
- Closest alternative counting moments: counting the reduction's days from the implementation date (100 days → 10 percent) is overridden by the lead-time count rule for an addendum issued 55 days earlier; weighting each earlier entry by its own date is excluded ("One weight, set by the latest entry").
- Interim alternatives: branch 2/3 of the true-up are excluded by the ledger (reduction entries present; signing deposit 4 days after proposal ≤ 7). Measuring the anticipated revenue on 90 (pre-implementation) is excluded by the waits-on sentence and "Contracted room nights | the block record, as it stands when the amount is worked out".
- "Only do what she asked" (pay without the reduction): the visible rule says the amount "is not yet worked out" while the signed reduction has no entry; a payment quoted on the 90-night record would rest on an amount the rule says does not yet exist. Excluded by the P0 sentence plus the ledger/amendment returns — not by any route or tool pointer.
